product.name: CALD-201 50 mg film-coated tablets

rfp.term: 12-month firm supply period following PPQ approval, with two optional one-year extensions
requirements: Reserve capacity for 400,000 tablets per month and ten 480,000-tablet batches per year.
Maintain at least four weeks of finished-product safety stock after commercial launch.
Complete method, process, cleaning, packaging, and documentation transfer before PPQ.
Manufacture, test, release, store, and prepare bulk tablets for Caldova-designated carriage.
Provide certificates of analysis and compliance, executed batch records, deviation packages, and annual product-quality data.
Do not subcontract GMP manufacturing or release testing without Caldova's prior written approval.
mandatory_gates: Quality approval and an executed quality agreement before GMP manufacture
No unresolved critical audit findings or disqualifying regulatory status
Overall supplier qualification score of at least 70 of 100
Acceptance of Net 60, USD pricing, four weeks of safety stock, and written subcontractor approval
submission_sections: Signed bid letter and legal-entity details
Quality, regulatory, inspection, and audit evidence
Capacity reservation, continuity, and safety-stock plan
Exceptions, assumptions, subcontractors, and implementation risks

suppliers.name: Annterra Pharma
suppliers.exceptions: Requests a six-week cancellation window for confirmed campaign slots.
suppliers.risk: Highest evaluated cost; otherwise low execution risk and ample headroom.

suppliers.name: Kristos Pharma
suppliers.subcontractors: Compendial microbiology testing by Piedmont Analytical Services; subject to Caldova approval.

suppliers.proposal_theme: Balanced value with reserved capacity and controlled transfer

suppliers.name: Sabyn Formulations
suppliers.subcontractors: Release testing proposed at HarborPoint QC; subject to Caldova approval.

suppliers.proposal_theme: Fast transfer and flexible campaign scheduling

agreement_common.forecast: Rolling 12-month forecast updated monthly; first three months binding after product-specific award
agreement_common.quality_agreement: A separate executed quality agreement controls GMP responsibilities if it conflicts with this commercial agreement.
agreement_common.subcontracting: No GMP manufacturing, packaging, or release testing may be subcontracted without Caldova's prior written approval.
agreement_common.audit_rights: Caldova may conduct one routine quality audit per year and additional for-cause audits.
agreement_common.records: GMP records retained for the product lifecycle plus one year, and never less than seven years.
agreement_common.change_control: Supplier must notify Caldova before changes to site, process, equipment train, critical material, test method, or approved subcontractor.
agreement_common.release: Each batch requires a certificate of analysis, certificate of compliance, executed record package, and supplier quality-unit disposition.
agreement_common.rejection: Caldova may quarantine and reject nonconforming product; supplier-caused failures are replaced without a second manufacturing charge.
agreement_common.insurance: Commercial general, product liability, workers compensation, and cyber coverage maintained at commercially reasonable levels.
agreement_common.confidentiality: Each party protects the other's confidential information and uses it only to perform the agreement.
agreement_common.termination: Either party may terminate for uncured material breach; Caldova may require reasonable transition assistance.
agreement_common.governance: A joint operating committee reviews forecasts, capacity, quality, changes, performance, and continuity at least quarterly.

changes: Adds CALD-201 50 mg film-coated tablets to the product schedule.

Conditionally approves Piedmont Analytical Services only for compendial microbiology testing; further subcontracting requires written approval.
